messages:
Priya (Product): Heads-up — FinServ pilot just asked for 7yr audit retention + tenant BYOK + SOC2 mapping. Need to decide what we scope into the Q4 compliance sprint. cc @Raj @Mia @Sam
Raj (Security): 7yr across the board or only certain event types?
Priya (Product): Their contract callout is auth events + data-access events. Legal is pushing broader, but my proposal: tiered retention — auth+access 7y, admin/ops telemetry 1y, metrics 90d.
Mia (Eng Infra): Tiered makes sense. Two quick asks: 1) rough storage/cost delta for 7y auth events vs 1y; 2) BYOK on-boarding complexity (KMS escrow/rotation). I can rough-estimate but need event volume sample.
Sam (SRE): Also need to think search/retention SLA — customers expect ability to query evidence within retention window. Cold-archive + export-only is cheaper but hurts query SLAs.
Raj (Security): BYOK implications: per-tenant keys, rotation policy, escrow for legal hold, and operator access model. I'd estimate 6–8 weeks eng + security work for a robust handshake + attestation. Also need a runbook for key compromise.
Legal (Counsel): We need to confirm regulatory requirements for FinServ pilot (certain jurisdictions mandate 7+ years). I will check and update by EOD.
Priya (Product): Draft launch criteria idea: 1) per-tenant retention config UI + API, 2) exportable audit bundle (signed), 3) BYOK onboarding flow + attestation docs, 4) SOC2 evidence mapping doc + verification checklist, 5) legalhold override flag. Comments?
Mia (Eng Infra): One more tradeoff: full-text audit search vs export-first. Full-text index for 7y blows storage and index cost. Suggest we offer 'search for last 1y' and export+reindex option for older windows.
Sam (SRE): Agree with that compromise. Add: provide an async job for reindexing exported bundles into a sandboxed search for investigations.
Raj (Security): Add threat mitigation: telemetry sampling and redact PII at ingest for long retention buckets. Also KMS rotation testing in staging must be part of rollout.
Priya (Product): Decision needed by Wed so we can freeze sprint scope. Proposed scope for Q4 MVP: per-tenant retention config, exportable signed bundles, BYOK handshake (limited to cloud KMS + escape hatch), and SOC2 mapping docs. Deferred: 7yr full-text search (opt-in roadmap).
Mia (Eng Infra): I can put together a rough-cost delta + storage plan by Tue. Will include estimated ops burden for long-retention indices.
Raj (Security): I'll draft the BYOK runbook and list required security controls by Tue.
Sam (SRE): I'll define search SLA options and an async reindex/export workflow by Tue.
Legal (Counsel): I'll confirm regulatory asks and any mandatory evidence formats by EOD.
Priya (Product): Thanks — action items: @Mia cost estimate, @Raj BYOK runbook, @Sam search SLA + reindex plan, @Legal confirm regs, I'll draft the launch criteria doc and circulate for sign-off. Please add any blockers in-thread. :thumbsup:
